I want to start by saying i’ve been taking my avocado here for a couple years now due to epilepsy. dr brown is truly amazing with her.

Dr. Jardine was truly, and i mean truly so compassionate during this time and Alonzo explained everything clearly. everyone was amazing and i will forever be grateful for them. thank you for being so gentle with my baby and giving me some time to grieve with him.

The doctor and the medical assistant also the clerk secretary were very helpful and professional it was my first time being a customer with my cat Batman and the doctor will explain all diagnosis of my Batman my Batman baby cat couldn't walk he was in so much pain after bringing Batman home in a few hours Batman was walking slowly but but no pain  . Dr. Brown was awesome and informative. They offered him a blanket since he was shaking and cold. The complimentary first time patient exam + welcome goodie bag was a plus and we left feeling at ease. Dr. Jardine is the best! She helped identify my cat (Cowboy) autoimmune disorder and get him on the right track. She’s always very kind and gentle and remembers cowboy every time we come in. If you’re looking for an amazing vet, she’s the best!

I love this place. My dog has the vet. Also twice a week I do dog daycare for him. If I want groom I can setup to have done during daycare. Same with seeing the vet! My dog thinks it is the best day of his life everytime

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this facility. From the beginning, I clearly communicated—both verbally and in writing—that my Shih Tzu, Popper, is a rescue who is fearful of unfamiliar people and can become reactive. I specifically explained that he only needed food, water, and occasional walks. He did not need playtime, petting, or unnecessary interaction.

Unfortunately, despite repeatedly communicating these instructions, they were not consistently followed.

During his first stay, a staff member attempted to pet Popper because he was “so cute,” despite my clear instructions. Popper reacted by biting the staff member, and I was contacted about the incident as though I were somehow responsible for what happened. This was especially frustrating because I had already warned them about his behavior.

During his third stay, I had him scheduled for grooming and provided sedation medication with very specific instructions. I asked that they first attempt grooming without it, but if he became agitated, they were to stop, administer the medication, and try again the following day. Instead, the groomer continued despite his distress and then charged an additional $75. I disputed the charge and was ultimately refunded.

I was then informed that Popper would be placed on a two-leash system because of his behavior, supposedly for staff safety. Yet again, I was told that staff had attempted to interact and play with him despite my repeated instructions not to do so. I was even asked if I could pick him up while I was out of the country and was told that they might reconsider accepting him for future stays.

By the fourth stay, I was again asked to complete an intake form and was ultimately told that Popper would need to be sedated in order for them to keep him.

At this point, I have completely lost confidence in their ability to properly care for my dog. I understand the importance of staff safety, but owners should be able to trust that trained professionals will listen to clear instructions and respect the boundaries established for their pets.

Popper was not a difficult dog without warning—his needs and triggers were communicated repeatedly. The issue was that those instructions were not consistently followed.

I ultimately canceled his upcoming appointment and will no longer be using their services. I sincerely hope they invest in better training and staff who are equipped to work with fearful, reactive, and rescue dogs while making both the animals and their owners feel safe and respected.

I am incredibly disappointed that Popper was not given the patience, understanding, and safe environment I specifically requested.
Phenomenal service. I’ve been with this vet for years and they are the only people I trust with my fur babies. They try to work with your schedule and have a fantastic team 🫶🐱
All my dogs and cats go here and we’ve always had great service. Knowledgeable staff, quick service and compassion.

Very friendly knowledgeable staff. They didn’t take long at all to help us and evaluate my dog Junior. They were sincere and caring and I was very pleased with my first visit!  We will be back when we need to see a vet again.
Love this place❤️🤗🐶 …

Our young Pomeranian broke his foot a few months ago and had to wear a cast. Since we couldn’t get the cast wet, we weren’t able to bathe him, and his long coat became extremely matted. We were so worried he would have to be shaved, and as Pomeranian owners know, that can sometimes affect how their coat grows back.

We took him to My Pet’s Vet, and Sasha was amazing from the start. She reassured us that she would do everything she could to remove the mats while trimming as little of his beautiful coat as possible.

A few hours later, she called to let us know he was ready. We couldn’t believe the transformation! She was able to remove all the matting without shaving him, and he looked absolutely adorable with his long, fluffy coat still intact. We were so relieved and grateful.

Thank you so much, Sasha, for taking such wonderful care of our baby. Your kindness, patience, and talent truly made all the difference. We’ll definitely be bringing him back for future grooming and will happily recommend you to our friends and family!

It is 5:50 pm.  My dog ate macadamia nuts, highly toxic.  I called them in a panic and they are willing to see him now, even so close to closing.  The team just knows how much we love these family members and share and act as if we are ohana!
Thank you!

I started bringing my two dogs to My Pets Vet at the beginning of this year, and we've probably been there about once a month ever since—for everything from vaccines and routine checkups to dental surgery.

At this point, I feel like I've met just about every veterinarian and vet tech there, and I honestly love every single one of them. Everyone is incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely sweet with my pups. They never make me feel rushed and always take the time to explain things, go over treatment options, and answer every question I manage to come up with.

One thing I appreciate more than anything is that they've never tried to take advantage of the fact that I'd do just about anything for my dogs. Instead of immediately recommending a long list of expensive tests, they start with the most obvious, least invasive, and most cost-effective approach whenever it's appropriate. That kind of honesty is hard to find.

We're also on their annual wellness plan, and it's been absolutely worth it. I truly feel like my pups are getting excellent care without completely emptying my wallet.

Most importantly, it just feels like everyone there genuinely cares—not only about their four-legged patients but also about the humans attached to the other end of the leash. As a pet parent, that's priceless.

I'm incredibly grateful I found My Pets Vet. My dogs may not get excited when we pull into the parking lot (they're no fans of vaccines!), but I always know they're in the best hands. Thank you to the entire team!
Very passionate and knowledgeable staff, your pet is in good hands here!
All employees were friendly and caring not just for the pets but also the pets parent

NINA stated that I needed to do more research, watch where I was going, that it wasnt their fault, and they are human, for voicing my concern. Thank you all for treating her with so much care. We are very grateful.

I went in for a free first time visit for my cat ended up payed$ 90  due to a infection ,got prescribed other medicine irrelevant to the issue at hand that ended up coming out to another $150 feel like they just try and get money out of you here . horrible service definitely do not recommend at all

They gave me an estimated quote of $700 to $800 so because I don't just have that kind of money I applied for $1000 credit.   My Pet's Vet ran up over $800 on I really don't know what vaccination exams exrays antibiotics. This place does not care about the animals they serve!!  They only care about the money they can squeeze out of the pet owners and if I just had money like this I would have just paid it all to make my senior fur baby better, but I don't and she has to pay because I'm poor and the Vets office is greedy! I wasn’t there 5 min by the time they took us back and another 5 when the tech student came in for vitals. Dr. Brown and the tech Alvaro were so gentle and kind with my Chula. Very impressed.

The doctor always provides a thorough and clear explanation at each appointment, taking the time to answer all of my questions and making sure I fully understand my pets’ care.

Their wellness plan is also incredibly helpful. It allows us to get all the necessary vaccines and exams without worry, which gives me real peace of mind knowing my pets are staying on track with their health.

The front desk staff is just as wonderful—friendly, helpful, and welcoming, even over the phone. From the moment we walk in, we feel genuinely cared for. Most importantly, they always make sure my pets are comfortable during their visits, which means so much to me as a pet owner. They have their own groomers, they do boarding, they have a doggy day camp all in one area. This place is by far the best type of facility to have your pet. Not just for older dogs but for all dogs! It makes not leaving your pet here, without any  worries of any kind, because if anything happens, I don’t have to go somewhere else to take my vet unless it is absolutely necessary by their vet.

I will keep him here until he transitions on whenever that may be.

My Lil old man Squirt passed away last November 2024. Very grateful to have found this place since their help did extend his life a little longer til the end.

MPP is an all inclusive place and I love that about them. You can have your pet’s Veternarian there and utilize their other services. if something goes wrong with your pet while there for any service, their Veternarian is there or another Veternarian or Nurse or Vet Technician can access your pets records to assist. Wonderful all around.

The daycare staff is great. They know how to attend to each pet’s individual needs as well as letting them adapt to boarding and like I said other pets. That is also a necessity, because things come up and I may need her to be boarded and be around other pets. They love on all the pets like their own and they provide daily progress notes and pictures so you can see what they are doing while there.
A new staff member has also added a monthly chart with additional pet activities for the pets and it is wonderful and I know it takes a lot of work to do by the daycare staff always do a great job. The dog enrichment added to with the monthly activity chart is one of the best I have ever seen and Im grateful to know of.

The daycare is also great because they put the dogs together based on size and temperament unlike most places, so you don’t have to worry about your dog being with a large group of bigger more aggressive dogs, which makes them safe.

Perhaps a bit different than most, he does better with us then apart bc he trusts his dad so much. Most vets don’t listen and insist on separating us and then can’t do what they’re trying to do bc he’s scared and aggressive. This vets office listens. Dr. Susie and Tech Sara(without an h) went out of their way to make him and us comfortable. There is no judgement for his personality. Honestly couldn’t reccomend them more. Ok. I have used this group some in the past. I have 2 dogs. Past 4 months I’ve brought both dogs in for annual stuff. I am trying to use this group as a full time provider for my 2 girls now.  I am a pet lover so money is not an issue on services, so when they do the add on sales stuff, I am usually in. This place is one of those places. Always up selling. The reason I’m chap and grading low is because my 10 year Doberman is on her last months of life. Blind and a diabetic that needs insulin twice a day. I called asking for antibiotics to help her through a sinus infection. She is miserable and a good 10 day round of antibiotics always does wonders to her spirits.
